author: Bjarn Bronsveld
why: Photographer explicitly documents an endemic giant tortoise in the Santa Cruz highlands near Santa Rosa. Walking animal in lush vegetation is the closest location-and-habitat match; a 3000px delivery URL.

author: Lloyd Douglas
